crossRefs.note: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for…
the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and…
“Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to…
You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

parallels.note: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.
He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

translations.web: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
translations.bsb: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
translations.kjv: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
translations.asv: they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,
